title: Rectangle Area
description: Calculate the total area covered by two rectilinear rectangles in a 2D plane, subtracting the overlap.
pseudocode:
1. area1 = (ax2 - ax1) * (ay2 - ay1)
2. area2 = (bx2 - bx1) * (by2 - by1)
3. overlapWidth = max(0, min(ax2, bx2) - max(ax1, bx1))
4. overlapHeight = max(0, min(ay2, by2) - max(ay1, by1))
5. overlapArea = overlapWidth * overlapHeight
6. return area1 + area2 - overlapArea

steps.note: Calculate area of the first rectangle: (3 - -3) * (4 - 0) = 6 * 4 = 24.
Calculate area of the second rectangle: (9 - 0) * (2 - -1) = 9 * 3 = 27.
